fact: A massive planet proposed at Aldebaran — the fiery eye of the Bull and a sci-fi waypoint.
bio: Aldebaran, the orange-giant eye of Taurus, is one of science fiction's most name-dropped stars, from pulp adventures to film. A planet several times Jupiter's mass was once proposed from decades of subtle velocity signals, but later analysis attributes those signals to the giant star's own pulsations — the planet is now considered unconfirmed — a reminder of how hard planets are to pin down around restless old suns.
